SELECT i.inbound_id, d.inbound_detail_id, p.product_name, d.quantity, i.is_refund, w.warehouse_name,
req.webuser_name AS requester_name, app.webuser_name AS approver_name, conf.webuser_name AS confirmer_name,
i.request_date AS requested_date, a.created_at AS approved_date, l.received_date, d.reason
FROM inbound_detail d JOIN inbound i ON i.inbound_id = d.inbound_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = d.product_id JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = d.warehouse_id
JOIN webuser req ON req.webuser_id = i.webuser_id
LEFT JOIN approval a ON a.inbound_id = i.inbound_id LEFT JOIN webuser app ON app.webuser_id = a.approver_id
LEFT JOIN lot_in l ON l.inbound_detail_id = d.inbound_detail_id LEFT JOIN webuser conf ON conf.webuser_id = l.confirmer_id
